text: Dusk's manipulation game hits full boil: he splits everyone up, sending Flint to sit alone while quietly promising Vale and Lumen he'll meet them at Loading Dock 7, then warns Flint off from following. Meanwhile Reed and Lumen are also heading to the dock "just to watch," Flint separately tells Vale to meet him there too, and Lumen still thinks she has a sweet blossom-picking date with Vale tomorrow. Nobody has told anybody else who's really going — Loading Dock 7 tonight is about to be way more crowded than any of them expect, and Dusk's whispers about "tremors in bread" and hidden deceit have everyone rattled but nobody's said no to him yet.
